localCandidates.title: There is Romance

localCandidates.note: 主候选：纯钢琴、慢而有旋律，适合图文回忆与书信。作者以持久爱意、婚礼场景形容。
localCandidates.changes: Full recording retained; transcoded to AAC 192k for local web playback. No edit, excerpt, fade, normalization, or added audio.

localCandidates.title: Reawakening
localCandidates.attribution: "Reawakening" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com). Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License. https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
localCandidates.note: 主候选：钢琴与大提琴，比纯钢琴更有包裹感。作者称其为安静交谈适用的爱情主题，56 bpm。
localCandidates.changes: Full recording retained; transcoded to AAC 192k for local web playback. No edit, excerpt, fade, normalization, or added audio.

localCandidates.title: Reverie
localCandidates.attribution: 'Reverie' by Scott Buckley – released under CC-BY 4.0. www.scottbuckley.com.au. https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
localCandidates.note: 氛围比较：柔化钢琴、弦乐与合成氛围，作者称之为亲密、梦境感。适合夜景/花海，情绪偏沉静。
localCandidates.changes: Full recording retained; transcoded to AAC 192k for local web playback. No edit, excerpt, fade, normalization, or added audio.

listeningReferences.title: River Flows in You
listeningReferences.purpose: 熟悉的旋律，流动感强，可作为整页温柔钢琴的口味参照。
listeningReferences.type: Official Artist Channel listening reference only; not downloaded

listeningReferences.title: Kiss the Rain
listeningReferences.purpose: 与雨夜回忆相呼应，情绪较内敛和怀念；不一定适合全程贯穿。
listeningReferences.type: Official Artist Channel listening reference only; not downloaded

listeningReferences.title: Love Me
listeningReferences.purpose: 另一首温柔钢琴口味参考，可与River Flows in You比较。
listeningReferences.type: Official Artist Channel listening reference only; not downloaded

listeningReferences.title: A Thousand Years
listeningReferences.purpose: 钢琴与大提琴，作者说明其婚礼意象；更适合花树至告白终章的情绪，而非安静阅读段。
listeningReferences.type: Official Artist Channel listening reference only; not downloaded

listeningReferences.title: One Summer’s Day
listeningReferences.purpose: 回忆、光线与景色的气质参考。使用2019器乐视频，不用2023英文演唱版本。
listeningReferences.type: Official Artist Channel listening reference only; not downloaded
